author: OpenBank Security
notes: Initial overlay for issue #10618 (ADR-0314 phase 0). Findings without a component-specific verdict below remain under_investigation until artifact-backed triage is recorded.

statements.action_statement: The latest release inventory reports at.yawk.lz4:lz4-java before 1.11.4, and current main still forces 1.11.1. The vulnerable native-library extraction path is present; component-specific proof that every published and deployed runtime uses only a private temporary directory, a system library, or a Java-only implementation is unavailable. Treat the published release as affected. Remediation candidate 92fb634a3e61a86bdd5877bf93db44262b6f93ce resolves 1.11.4 and its exact-SHA Services CI run 38233010737 succeeded, but the candidate has not been reviewed, merged, released or deployed. Review and merge the upgrade under normal controls, rebuild each affected component, verify the new release SBOM and image digest resolve 1.11.4, then confirm deployment where applicable. Change this verdict to fixed only for the verified patched release; track delivery in #12609.
